email_summary:
Summarize the following email. State the decision, owner, deadline, risks, and next actions.

Subject: Database migration readiness

Team,

We plan to move the customer analytics service from the legacy PostgreSQL cluster to the new high-availability cluster on October 18 at 02:00 UTC. Priya owns the migration. Marco will validate backups by October 14, and Elena will run the restore rehearsal by October 15. The application team must freeze schema changes after October 16 at 18:00 UTC. The principal risk is that two reporting jobs still use hardcoded host names; those jobs must be changed before the rehearsal. If restore validation fails or replication lag exceeds five minutes, we will postpone the migration by one week. Please reply with blockers before Friday at noon.

Thanks,
Jordan

The C program should validate and aggregate CSV rows, Python should call the compiled C library and insert results safely, and SQL should define the table plus a parameterized summary query. Explain build and execution commands, error handling, and ownership boundaries.
systems_explanation: Explain how a heterogeneous CPU thread pool schedules independent matrix tiles across faster and slower cores while preserving deterministic reductions. Include a concrete example, identify false-sharing and barrier risks, and distinguish static scheduling from dynamic work stealing.
structured_json: Return only valid JSON describing an inference benchmark. Use fields model, prompt_tokens, decode_tokens, prefill_ms, decode_ms, status, and notes. Use plausible example values and no Markdown fences.
